_comment: Contains ONLY the models named in ARCHITECTURE.md section 8. Nothing here
is inferred from a model name.
Every unknown value is null on purpose:
input_cost / output_cost / cost_unit  - pricing is not documented anywhere
max_context_tokens                    - context windows are not documented
quality_score / latency_score         - measured from telemetry, not assumed
supports_tools / structured_output    - not documented per model
modality                              - see the note on each entry
Filtering treats null as 'unknown', and unknown never satisfies a
requirement. A model stays out of a candidate set until someone fills in
the metadata that proves it qualifies.
To complete an entry, set the values from the provider's own documentation
or from measured telemetry. Do not guess.
ARCHITECTURE.md section 8: 'Available text/reasoning models are registered
through configuration and database metadata.' No text or reasoning model is
named in any source document, so none is seeded here. Add them to this file

models._modality_note: Not set. The modality vocabulary (text/image/multimodal/structured) has no entry that is documented for this model, and choosing one would be a guess. supports_vision below is what compatibility filtering uses.
models._supports_vision_note: Listed under 'Example vision models' in ARCHITECTURE.md section 8.
Listed under 'Example vision models' in ARCHITECTURE.md section 8.

models._modality_note: An embedding model over text. This is the one seeded modality that follows directly from the documented capability.
models._supports_embeddings_note: Listed under 'Embedding model' in ARCHITECTURE.md section 8.

models._modality_note: Audio input has no value in the documented modality vocabulary (text/image/multimodal/structured). Left null rather than mislabelled; see the open item raised with this implementation.
